name: Somchai Chansri
bio:
Somchai Chansri's career began not on the racetrack, but in the Royal Thai Police, where he spent two decades honing his skills in security and risk management. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, he transitioned to the private sector, specializing in security for high-profile events. His meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to safety caught the eye of Trident's management, who recruited him to oversee all aspects of team security.

Somchai's philosophy is simple: prevention is paramount. He emphasizes thorough planning, proactive risk assessment, and the establishment of robust security protocols. He believes in empowering his team through comprehensive training and fostering a culture of vigilance. His calm demeanor and decisive leadership inspire confidence throughout the organization, ensuring the safety and security of personnel and assets.

What sets Somchai apart is his innovative approach to security. He constantly researches and implements cutting-edge technologies and methodologies, staying ahead of potential threats and ensuring that Trident remains at the forefront of motorsport security practices.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A wiry man with a stern but kind face, he carries himself with a quiet authority.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn book on crisis management.
Insists on a daily security briefing, no matter how trivial it seems.
Secretly enjoys karaoke after a successful race weekend.
